name: playwright-bdd-cucumber-framework
description: Playwright BDD testing framework with Cucumber and JavaScript

scripts.test: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --profile chromium; npm run report:html
scripts.test:demo: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --profile chromium --tags @demo; npm run report:html
scripts.test:chromium: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --profile chromium; npm run report:html
scripts.test:firefox: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --profile firefox; npm run report:html
scripts.test:webkit: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --profile webkit; npm run report:html
scripts.test:all-browsers: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --profile chromium; cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --profile firefox; cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --profile webkit; npm run report:html
scripts.test:regression: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --profile chromium --tags @regression; npm run report:html

author: Ky Nguyen
